_about: Numbers cited by the agentic-research-harness kit. Every entry has class 'public' (a real value from a cited public source, or my arithmetic on one) or 'illustrative' (a round number invented to explain an idea, a design parameter of the method, or output of a demonstration simulator; never a measurement of a real platform). No result of the internal first campaign is reproduced: its entries keep only the shape of the story. Load this file; do not retype the numbers.

pub_strathern_year.source: Strathern, 'Improving ratings: audit in the British University system', European Review 5(3):305-321, 1997

pub_goodhart_year.source: Goodhart, 'Problems of monetary management: the U.K. experience', Papers in Monetary Economics, Reserve Bank of Australia, 1975

pub_react_year.source: Yao et al., 'ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models', arXiv:2210.03629, 2022 (ICLR 2023)

pub_liu_layland_year.source: Liu & Layland, 'Scheduling Algorithms for Multiprogramming in a Hard-Real-Time Environment', JACM 20(1):46-61, 1973

pub_edf_utilization_bound.source: Liu & Layland 1973, Theorem 7: EDF schedules a set of independent periodic tasks with deadline = period on one preemptive processor iff total utilization <= 1

pub_rm_bound_limit.source: Liu & Layland 1973: the rate-monotonic bound n(2^(1/n)-1) tends to ln 2 as n grows; value is my arithmetic

pub_amdahl_year.source: Amdahl, 'Validity of the single processor approach to achieving large scale computing capabilities', AFIPS Spring Joint Computer Conference, 1967

pub_heft_year.source: Topcuoglu, Hariri, Wu, 'Performance-effective and low-complexity task scheduling for heterogeneous computing' (HEFT), IEEE TPDS 13(3):260-274, 2002

pub_popper_year.source: Popper, The Logic of Scientific Discovery, English edition, Hutchinson, 1959

pub_disjoint_null_probability_20v20.source: my arithmetic: if candidate and champion samples are 20 i.i.d. draws each from one continuous distribution, every ordering of the 40 values is equally likely, so P(all 20 candidate values below all 20 champion values) = 1 / C(40,20) = 1 / 137 846 528 820

pub_median_null_probability.source: my arithmetic: under the same no-difference assumption, the candidate's median is below the champion's median with probability 1/2 (symmetry)
